corpus_policy.selection: First consecutive nonoverlapping 513-token blocks from each pinned body anchor; no shuffle, filtering or candidate-dependent selection
corpus_policy.tokenization: Pinned Qwen tokenizer; add_special_tokens=False; no chat template or normalization
corpus_policy.partition: Different books and authors; calibration only chooses format, heldout never tunes it
corpus_policy.format_selection: Among 32F16,64F32,64F16,128F16 (<=8.5 matrix bits/weight), minimize calibration mean KL, then maximize top1, then minimize cross entropy, then label

identity.execution: Layer-major; 256-token priming batch then single-token cached calls; one layer KV resident

tokenizer_transfer.policy: Identical verified tokenizer blobs; reuse original corpus IDs and scored positions without retokenization
